answer: Each epoch issues a fresh set of required words, and duplicate or near-duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger by hash, so one generated text cannot be replayed across 9 accounts. A farm must therefore produce 9 genuinely different texts, and its reused grove of copies collapses to a single submission. The wharf of effort per account rises sharply, and the timber payoff of a copy-paste strategy drops to zero. All of it is verifiable from the public ledger, so no trust in the operator is required.
